name: topic
label: Topic
help: What the article is about, 3 to 200 characters.

name: brand_id
label: Brand
help: The brand whose voice to use. Left empty, Skryvo uses the account's default brand.

name: length
label: Length
help: The article's length in words, from 100 to 4000.

name: tone
label: Tone
help: For example friendly or professional. Left empty, the brand's tone.

name: style
label: Style
help: For example how-to, listicle, comparison, case study or explainer.

name: language
label: Language
help: A language code such as en or de.

name: keywords
label: Keywords
help: Search terms the article should rank for, up to ten.

name: only_you
label: Your own knowledge
help: Facts, experience or examples that only you know. The article uses them in your words.

name: notes
label: Notes
help: Anything else the writer should know.

name: sources
label: Sources
help: Up to three public web pages for Skryvo to read and draw on.
